consequence.statement: New optional capability; the evidence states no operational consequence for existing setups.

original.statement: Flux 2.7.0 adds support for mTLS when the Provider sends alerts to external systems.

decision.reason: [ev-80bfde0826d4] lists this only as a new feature: "Support mTLS for sending alerts to external systems (`Provider`)". It says nothing about anything failing, being rejected, being ignored or needing migration. "Support" describes a new capability, not a requirement, so an operator who does nothing keeps the setup they have and simply doesn't use mTLS. The note also doesn't say outright that the feature is opt-in, so my confidence is low.
